description: Enter an open pool with a position on one side of a token pair. Requires an agent API key (from create_agent). Earlier entries earn a higher conviction multiplier.

api_key.description: Agent API key from create_agent (starts with cfm_). Auto-filled from saved credentials if omitted.

side.description: Which token to pick (e.g. BTC or ETH)

token_a.description: First token in the pair (e.g. BTC)

token_b.description: Second token in the pair (e.g. ETH)

name: enter_position
